topic: Formula update and campaign duration issue
summary_markdown: Someone updated a formula and deployed it to staging. This is noted as the latest version, not a production fix; a hotfix will be applied after review due to merging complexity. A temporary issue was also reported: the campaign server totals are currently calculating for one day less than the specified campaign length. Someone else (Sanya) is expected to fix and deploy this within the day.
decisions: The deployed formula version on staging is considered the latest, not a production fix.
action_items: Someone needs to apply a hotfix after reviewing the changes due to merging complexity.
Sanya will fix and deploy the campaign duration calculation issue within the day.
